change_summary: Observed-only broad-universe state attribution over 7 allocator source families (617 rows, 380 tickers, 28 cells): exactly one router candidate survived the predeclared ex-top-ticker robustness screen (industry_stable_core_flow x mixed|balanced|normal); justifies one separate frozen Gate 1-4 router experiment; no strategy behavior changed.
hypothesis: Broad-universe accepted allocator sources (~1237-ticker warehouse, 8 source families, expected 1000+ source trades) may contain market-state cells whose edge survives an ex-top-ticker robustness screen, identifying regime-router candidates that the thin 20-ticker consensus-sleeve sample could not support.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not Gate-4 the near-miss cells: lagged consensus x mixed|balanced|normal remains blocked on APP concentration (exp-20260612-018/020), compression x same cell is single-name driven (ex-top edge +0.1pp), and the broad_down industry_laggard cell has n=5. Do not re-screen the same 28 cells with relaxed thresholds or alternative state classifiers to manufacture more survivors.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: The one survivor (industry_stable_core_flow x mixed|balanced|normal) is now the predeclared candidate for a single frozen Gate 1-4 router experiment: bounded notional tilt on that source inside the accepted allocator stack, comparator = accepted exp-20260611-005 allocator, with the same dual concentration guards. Caveat for that experiment: the cell edge is weakest in late_strong (+0.19%/trade), so zero-regression risk is concentrated there. For everything else, new evidence means closed forward rows.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: One cell cleanly survived the ex-top-ticker screen: industry_stable_core_flow x mixed|balanced|normal (n=32, 31 unique tickers, top ticker TOST only 20.9% of positive PnL, in-cell +2.93%/trade vs -0.22% in all other states, edge +3.14pp, ex-top edge +2.21pp, positive all 3 windows both raw and ex-top). The near-misses validated the screen: lagged consensus x same cell failed exactly on APP 51.4% share, and compression x same cell collapsed from +2.3pp to +0.1pp ex-top.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: the consensus-sleeve state cell failed only on single-name concentration (exp-20260612-018/020), and its ex-APP edge stayed positive in 2 of 3 windows, suggesting state structure exists but the 64-row core-universe sample is too thin to separate regime effect from one name. The broad allocator sources offer 10-20x more rows across 1237 tickers where no single name should dominate a cell. Main disconfirmers: per-source state cells may still be thin once split 8 ways by 15 states, broad momentum sources may show uniform state response (smear), and with ~120 cells screened the multiple-testing risk is high, which is why this run is observed-only and any candidate must clear the predeclared ex-top-ticker robustness screen before a separate Gate 1-4.
